info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Market Data Operational Actions API
info.description: The Market Data Operational Actions API allows consumers to access detailed operational actions related to market data from various information providers. This endpoint retrieves specific operational insights and metrics based on the provided parameters, facilitating efficient decision-making in trading and investment strategies. Typical users include financial analysts, traders, and application developers who need up-to-date operational data for market analysis. Integrating this API enhances visibility into operational performance, enabling data-driven responses to market changes.
